title: Marsa chart values
description: Value surface for the Marsa umbrella chart. Bundled-component MVP (Postgres only) per AgDR-0004; public-ingress TLS via Traefik ACME resolver per AgDR-0005. additionalProperties is false at every level so off-happy-path keys (e.g. externalDatabase.host) fail loudly instead of being silently ignored.

image.description: Container images for the Marsa app. tag defaults to .Chart.AppVersion when blank.

email.description: Contact email for Let's Encrypt ACME registration (expiry notices). Override the placeholder before any public deployment.

marsaUserPassword.description: Password for the marsa DB role. Blank = auto-generate on first install and persist in the postgres-secrets Secret (reused on upgrade). Set only to pin a password on first install.

adminPassword.description: Password for the postgres superuser. Blank = auto-generate on first install. Same generate-once/reuse semantics as marsaUserPassword.

storageSize.description: PVC size for the Postgres data volume (Kubernetes quantity, e.g. 2Gi). Immutable after first install — changing it makes helm upgrade fail rather than lose data.

enabled.description: Enable public-facing HTTPS via the K3s Traefik Let's Encrypt cert resolver (AgDR-0005).

domain.description: Public domain Marsa is served on. Required — it drives the IngressRoute Host rules (web on <domain>, api on api.<domain>) whether or not TLS is enabled.

tag.description: Image tag. Blank defaults to the chart's appVersion.
